verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own Status Pages product is documented as giving real-time visibility into incident resolution status and letting PagerDuty users proactively communicate operational updates from inside the platform. That covers the 'updates without joining the war room' core. The evidence does not show stakeholders subscribing to updates, internal-only (private) audiences, or a structured update format. Missing for 10: documented stakeholder subscription mechanism, internal/private stakeholder audience scoping, structured update templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, internal stakeholders get structured incident updates they can subscribe to, without joining the war room

citations.quote: PagerDuty Status Pages provide visual, real-time insights into an organization's operations, and the status of incident resolution.
PagerDuty users can proactively and securely communicate real-time operational updates without context switching to other tools, giving users one platform, PagerDuty, as the single source of truth.
